summary: Prompts with a token id one past the vocabulary are rejected again when the tokenizer counts added tokens in its size
details: The largest accepted prompt token id was taken from the tokenizer's vocabulary size instead of size minus one. With VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS=1, whose size includes added tokens, DeepSeek-V4.x accepted token 129280, one past the embedding table; such prompts now get a validation error.
